content.text:
**Finding: compliant (rule not engaged) — § 8.3, p0363.**

The RENEWAL rule has no target in this document. This is a securitization transfer and servicing agreement whose term is event-based, not a fixed term with renewals: § 8.3 terminates the Agreement automatically on the earlier of payoff/disposition of the last Receivable or termination of the Issuer under the Trust Agreement.

Investigation performed:
- Read the planner's candidates (p0363, p0392, p0252) and all of Article VIII.
- "renew" returns zero hits document-wide; "automatically" hits only the successor-servicer appointment (p0335).
- Extension/successive/initial-term searches surface only Receivable-level payment extensions and Upgrade Offers — nothing about the Agreement's own term.
- No prior-notice window language ("days prior written notice") anywhere.

Article VIII contains only exit mechanics (Optional Acquisition/Clean-Up Redemption under § 8.1, Optional Redemption under § 8.2), not extensions. There is no auto-renewal trigger, renewal term, non-renewal notice window, or renewal price-uplift clause to test against the ≤30/≤60-day and CPI/3% parameters, and the self-terminating structure runs in our favour. No redline proposed.

Noted in the rationale rather than flagged: since no renewal construct exists, the preferred elements (vendor reminder, opt-out notice, uplift cap) have nothing to attach to — if a term-and-renewal construct is added later, the preferred position should be applied at that point.
